en.title: November 12: A Gyeongin Day's Metal Looks Set to Cut Wood, but Its Hidden Name Is Pine-and-Cypress Wood - 3 Zodiac Animals Rooting Into the Luck
en.excerpt: Today's saju day pillar looks like Metal cutting Wood, but its hidden name is Pine-and-Cypress Wood - the evergreen that doesn't fall. Here are the three zodiac animals rooting into that luck today, and why.

zh.title: 11月12日：庚寅日表面是金克木，暗藏的名字却是松柏木 - 运势最旺的3个生肖

fr.title: 12 novembre : un jour Gyeongin où le Métal semble trancher le Bois, mais dont le nom caché est le Bois de Pin et de Cyprès - 3 signes du zodiaque chinois qui prennent racine
